name: 海洋V·星月传奇
english_name: Ocean V: Star and Moon Legend
english_description: The game calls itself Ocean V, with the in-game banner name Star and Moon Legend (displayed as 〈Ocean V — Star and Moon Legend〉 on login). It's a successor within the classic “ES II” engine family's Ocean II branch — an independent evolution of haiyang2 (Ocean II) in this project — and is the largest archive processed in this project to date, with roughly 57,000 source files in its working directory.
